description: Manage Featureflip feature flags, targeting and rollouts from AI agents and editors.
name: io.github.canopy-labs/featureflip

environmentVariables.description: Featureflip API token. A personal token (ffp_) acts as you; a service token (ffs_) is a scoped machine identity for CI and agents.
environmentVariables.name: FEATUREFLIP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Management API base URL. Defaults to https://api.featureflip.io.
environmentVariables.name: FEATUREFLIP_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Organization slug. Only needed for a personal token that can reach more than one organization.
environmentVariables.name: FEATUREFLIP_ORG

title: Featureflip
